note: Host policies, not measured motor performance. io_limit_s bounds the complete read/write cycle as well as each call. Live limits require loaded evidence, including jerk. A live owner explicitly activates a captured fixed pose and retains torque until supported release; no automatic alignment, reconnect or fault release.
commissioning_limits_note: Command and tracking policy for supervised initial trials, not measured motor capability. Continuous derivative caps match the planner. Encoded finite differences allow only mathematically bounded one-count quantization error. Servos retain their onboard control settings.
